EC1: Inability to comply with study requirements.
EC3: Patients with orthopedic or neuromuscular disorders [OR] that preclude participation in exercise.
EC5: History of MI [OR], angina [OR] or congestive heart failure.
EC7: Patients that are high risk for moderate exercise based on ACSM risk classification.
EC8: Patients who exceed minimal physical activity recommendations from the US Surgeon General's Report: Accumulation of 30 minutes or more of moderate physical activity on most days of the week.
